clause.description: References in this finding's framework, separated by commas, e.g. 's.8(5), Rule 7(2)' or 'Art. 32(1)(a)'. Validation checks that each section, rule or article number exists, not sub-clauses or whether it applies.

cross_reference.description: The equivalent clause in the other framework, e.g. 'GDPR Art. 33(1)', and any sector instrument, e.g. 'CERT-In Directions 2022'. Free text; nothing validates it.

file.description: Source file path relative to the audited codebase's root, if code-related. Never absolute, and never the data itself.
